value.rationale: The ten moduli are the entire natural first two nontrivial levels of the squarefree divisor lattice on four odd primes. The theorem gives the exact sharp uncovered count, not just the known qualitative noncovering result, and exposes a structural phase transition at the smallest prime 3 from a constant loss of 3 to q+2. It is a reproducible parameter-uniform extremal classification, with explicit optimizers and quantified residual coverage useful in small-prime sieve modeling.
